interpretationRules: Never use display products of Research Station or AL Scanner research as physical component outputs.
Research authorization is reusable per recipe; pay sample + blank Data Stick once per research instance, not once per manufacturing batch.
True Research Station output is encoded Data Stick, not displayed component. Dataset special-slot consumed:false is a UI placement flag here, contradicted by actual consumption code.

A generic Data Orb/Stick is not equivalent to one carrying specific NBT. Element scanning consumes sample+blank Data Orb and produces encoded authorization; replicator requires exact element authorization.
Do not convert raw Research Station durationTicks to seconds: it is a computation display quantity. Long metadata is lost in this export; report rate/time uncertainty.
IDs retain local-2.9.0-beta-2 prefix from exporter; source.datasetVersionId declares RC2. Preserve exact source_id keys for application.
